Rules source: Tempest Mk III — Ship Rules and Upgrade Catalogue, pages 3–5 (provided player handbook). Upgrade mechanics and token prices follow the handbook; build picks, crew plans and advice are recommendations, not additional game rules.

Modelling assumptions & notes
  • Builds assume no upgrades have already been purchased. The ship begins at Hull AC 15, Hull HP 150, Stability 3/3, Morale 2/3 and 6 Repair Supplies.
  • Stats show the fully stocked ship immediately after installation, before damage or use of supplies. Conditional abilities do not increase permanent stat maximums. No module confers extra Repair Supplies or Intelligence ability scores.
  • Weapon damage-per-round estimates assume 65% hit probability for Expected DPR, normal range, independent gun operators and operator-managed reloads; they exclude critical hits, resistances and conditional Arc Coil chain damage. The 65% probability is an illustrative assumption, not a ship statistic.
  • Ship weapon attacks use the operator’s Intelligence, Wisdom, or Dexterity modifier plus proficiency bonus.
  • The Lift Lions serve as independent safety inspectors; the Von Brim brothers remain mandatory ship owners.
  • Crew rosters use at least 20 operating personnel (excluding independent Lift Lions inspectors) and propose alternating duty watches. This staffing minimum and the watch plans are expedition recommendations, not handbook requirements.
  • The crew still has only one specialist action each round at initiative 10; it can fire, reload, repair, assist, or complete an objective step. At Stability 0, the ship normally has three rounds before forced landing or collision.
  • Custom configurations are saved in this browser when local file storage is available; sharing the HTML file does not transfer the browser’s saved selections.
